issues.description: Extraction requires data/stories/manifest.json and story files, but the repo only contains an empty data/stories directory.
The advertised tiny end-to-end test fails from a clean checkout because required story data is missing.
The documented tiny demo commands do not work from the checked-in repository state.
README claims stories can be loaded or generated, but the implementation only loads preexisting files.
pca_components_for_variance returns one component for threshold 0 instead of zero components.
project_out_components can project out too much when components are rank-deficient or duplicated.
Config values are cast but not validated, so empty emotions, bad counts, invalid fractions, or negative token starts fail later with unclear errors.
Validation loads vector artifacts without checking manifest/backend/model/dimension compatibility against the selected config.
Preference steering also trusts vector artifacts without compatibility or shape validation.
Custom emotion sets with no matching built-in scenarios can crash or produce invalid empty-statistic summaries.
HF backend treats dtype auto as full precision and loads the full model before moving devices, making the default target prone to memory failure.
HF preference scoring assumes good/bad tokenize to usable first tokens, which is tokenizer-dependent and unchecked.
Config value steering.min_reported_emotions is ignored and four steered emotions are hard-coded.
Dependencies have no upper bounds or lockfile, reducing reproducibility for numerical and model-backend behavior.
